title: Genealogy from Adam to Noah

questions.question: Who was first made in the likeness of God?
questions.explanation: Genesis 5:1: "When God created man, he made him in the likeness of God."

questions.question: What are the names of Noah's three sons?
questions.explanation: Genesis 5:32: "Noah fathered Shem, Ham, and Japheth."

questions.question: Who lived the longest in the Bible?
questions.explanation: Genesis 5:27: Methuselah lived 969 years, the longest recorded lifespan.

questions.question: Who was Adam's son born in his own likeness?
questions.explanation: Genesis 5:3: "Adam fathered a son in his own likeness... and named him Seth."

questions.question: What happened to Enoch?
options: God took him and he did not die
questions.correctAnswer: God took him and he did not die
questions.explanation: Genesis 5:24: "Enoch walked with God, and he was not, for God took him."

questions.question: How old was Adam when he died?
questions.explanation: Genesis 5:5: "Thus all the days that Adam lived were 930 years, and he died."

questions.question: What was unique about Enoch compared to others in this chapter?
options: He walked with God and did not die
questions.correctAnswer: He walked with God and did not die
questions.explanation: Genesis 5:24: Unlike others who "died," Enoch "was not, for God took him."

questions.question: How old was Noah when his three sons were born?
questions.explanation: Genesis 5:32: "After Noah was 500 years old, Noah fathered Shem, Ham, and Japheth."

questions.question: Who was Methuselah's father?
questions.explanation: Genesis 5:21: "When Enoch had lived 65 years, he fathered Methuselah."

questions.question: What phrase is repeated about each person in this chapter?
questions.explanation: The phrase "and he died" is repeated for each patriarch, except Enoch.

questions.question: Who was the father of Enoch (the one who walked with God)?
questions.explanation: Genesis 5:18: "When Jared had lived 162 years, he fathered Enoch."

questions.question: How many years did Enoch live before God took him?
questions.explanation: Genesis 5:23: "Thus all the days of Enoch were 365 years."

questions.question: Who was Noah's father?
questions.explanation: Genesis 5:28-29: "When Lamech had lived 182 years, he fathered a son and called his name Noah."

questions.question: What did Lamech prophesy about his son Noah?
options: He would bring relief from toil and pain
questions.correctAnswer: He would bring relief from toil and pain
questions.explanation: Genesis 5:29: "Out of the ground... this one shall bring us relief from our work and painful toil."

questions.question: In the genealogy, who came immediately after Seth?
questions.explanation: Genesis 5:6: "When Seth had lived 105 years, he fathered Enosh."

key_verse_text: Enoch walked with God, and he was not, for God took him.
